2118133285582692499.en_summary: Still a tricky time for most of Tech despite $MSFT & $AAPL pushing to new all-time highs. Equal-weighted $SPX +7.5% since Oct 1 and back at new ATH today, DJIA rose 1500. Tech needs time to stabilize due to underperformance in Semis/Memory/AI infrastructure; $MAGS and IGV better near-term. Key risks: US Dollar and rates higher in Nov. 3/1 positive breadth day and volatility collapse welcome for equities.
2118133285582692499.zh_summary: 儘管 $MSFT 與 $AAPL 創下新高，大多數科技股仍處棘手時期。等權重 $SPX 自10月1日以來上漲7.5%，今日重回新高，道指上漲1500點。科技股因半導體/記憶體/AI基建表現落後需時間穩定；$MAGS 與 IGV 近期較佳。主要風險：11月美元與利率走高。3/1正向廣度日及波動率崩潰對股市是歡迎步驟。

2118131188984684800.en_summary: $SPOT CFO: Total revenue was EUR 5 billion, growing 14% year-over-year. Premium revenue rose 15% YoY, driven by subscriber growth of 9% and ARPU expansion of 7.5%. Ad-supported revenue growth improved to 9% this quarter, led by strong growth in automated biddable sales channel.
2118131188984684800.zh_summary: $SPOT CFO：總收入50億歐元，年增14%。高級收入年增15%，由訂戶增長9%及ARPU擴張7.5%推動。廣告支持收入本季增長改善至9%，由自動化競價銷售渠道強勁增長帶動。

ticker_notes.SPOT: revenue EUR 5B +14% YoY, premium +15%, subs +9%, ARPU +7.5%

2118130728328442167.en_summary: Silver bulls: chart shows falling wedge with final low slightly below 50-year support. Prices after escaping falling wedge typically roll out not burst out. Outlook for sharply higher prices in years ahead for $SI_F. Hoping for low $40s but not likely under wedge interpretation.
2118130728328442167.zh_summary: 白銀多頭：圖表顯示下降楔形，最終低點略低於50年支撐。脫離下降楔形後價格通常逐步展開而非爆發。$SI_F 未來數年價格大幅走高前景。希望低40美元但按楔形解讀不太可能。

2118129915396825366.en_summary: $AMD sold on fears of data center slowdown even as its data center revenue nearly doubled to $8.5B and CEO Lisa Su laid out more than 80% company growth for 2027. Overlooked: AMD sells compute wherever racks get built and AI agents create enormous CPU demand around orchestration, databases and tool use; management expects server CPU revenue to double next year.
2118129915396825366.zh_summary: $AMD 因數據中心放緩恐懼而被賣出，儘管數據中心收入近乎翻倍至85億美元，CEO Lisa Su 提出2027年公司增長超過80%。被忽視的是：AMD 在機架建設處銷售計算，AI代理在編排、數據庫與工具使用產生巨大CPU需求；管理層預期明年伺服器CPU收入翻倍。

ticker_notes.AMD: DC rev nearly doubled to $8.5B, >80% growth 2027, server CPU to double next year
